permutationLabel: Elderly on steroids + NSAIDs: signs masked, afebrile sepsis
summary: 81-year-old woman on prednisolone and naproxen, 26 h vague abdominal discomfort, new confusion, afebrile, HR 106, BP 96/58, RR 22, WBC 6.1, lactate 3.1, AKI; soft abdomen; CT pneumoperitoneum from a duodenal perforation.

inputs.hpi: Daughter reports 26 hours of 'indigestion' then vague discomfort across the abdomen; since this morning she is muddled and sleepy. Not eating. No vomiting. Takes prednisolone 15 mg daily for polymyalgia rheumatica and naproxen for knee pain.

exam.general: Drowsy but rousable, confused. Temperature 36.9°C, pulse 106/min, BP 96/58, RR 22, SpO2 93% on air.
exam.abdomen: Mildly distended with diffuse mild tenderness. No guarding, no rigidity (on long-term steroids).

imaging.name: CT abdomen/pelvis with IV contrast
imaging.result: Pneumoperitoneum with free fluid; defect in the anterior wall of the duodenal bulb consistent with a perforated duodenal ulcer.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Perforated duodenal ulcer
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Perforated duodenal ulcer in an 81-year-old on steroids and NSAIDs — peritonism masked, afebrile, WBC normal. Boey 3 (shock, major medical illness, perforation >24 h). Sepsis with AKI. Emergency surgery after resuscitation; steroid cover.

guideline.name: WSES guidelines — perforated and bleeding peptic ulcer
guideline.section: CT/erect CXR for free air; early source control (laparoscopic or open repair / omental patch); broad-spectrum antibiotics; resuscitation; H. pylori testing and eradication; risk scores (Boey, PULP)
guideline.citation: Tarasconi A, Coccolini F, Biffl WL, et al. Perforated and bleeding peptic ulcer: WSES guidelines. World J Emerg Surg. 2020;15:3.

guideline.name: Surviving Sepsis Campaign — international guidelines for sepsis and septic shock 2021
guideline.section: Screening (do not use qSOFA alone), antibiotics within 1 h of shock, blood cultures, lactate, 30 mL/kg crystalloid for hypoperfusion, vasopressors, source control
guideline.citation: Evans L, Rhodes A, Alhazzani W, et al. Surviving Sepsis Campaign: international guidelines for management of sepsis and septic shock 2021. Crit Care Med. 2021;49:e1063–e1143.

guideline.name: Third international consensus definitions for sepsis and septic shock (Sepsis-3)
guideline.citation: Singer M, Deutschman CS, Seymour CW, et al. JAMA. 2016;315:801–10.

guideline.name: Boey score (perforated peptic ulcer)
guideline.section: Major medical illness, pre-operative shock (SBP <100 mmHg), perforation >24 h: 0–3
guideline.citation: Boey J, Choi SK, Poon A, Alagaratnam TT. Risk stratification in perforated duodenal ulcers. A prospective validation of predictive factors. Ann Surg. 1987;205:22–6.

rationale: Permutation: age and steroids. Steroids and age remove rigidity, fever and leucocytosis; the engines must still raise the perforation from imaging, recognise sepsis from qSOFA/lactate without fever, and plan surgery with steroid cover.
